exercises.name: 21s (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A biceps curl set of 21 reps that keeps the muscle working hard. Do 7 half reps from the bottom to halfway, 7 from halfway to the top, then 7 full reps. Keep your elbows pinned and go lighter than usual.

exercises.name: 4-Way Neck (Machine)
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the neck in all four directions on a neck machine: forward, back and to each side. Move slowly through a small, comfortable range and keep the rest of your body still.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
exercises.instructions: A seated mobility drill for hip rotation. Sit with both knees bent to 90°, one leg in front of you and one out to the side, then sit tall and lean gently over the front shin. Switch sides.

exercises.name: A-Skip
exercises.instructions: A running drill that trains knee drive and a quick, springy foot strike. Skip forward, lifting one knee to hip height while the other foot strikes the ground under your hips, with your arms swinging in rhythm.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine crunch for the abs. Set the chest pad, curl your ribs down toward your hips by rounding your spine, pause, then return slowly without letting the stack touch down.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.instructions: A tough core exercise that trains your abs to resist arching. Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders, roll forward as far as you can without your lower back sagging, then pull back with your abs.

exercises.name: Active Hang
exercises.instructions: A hang that builds grip and shoulder-blade strength. Hang from a bar with straight arms, then pull your shoulders down away from your ears so your body rises slightly, and hold.

exercises.name: Aerobics
exercises.instructions: Rhythmic, full-body cardio set to music: steps, kicks and arm moves at a steady pace. Builds endurance and coordination.

exercises.name: Alternating Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A dumbbell bench press done one arm at a time while the other holds at the top. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps and makes your core work to keep you steady on the bench.

exercises.name: Alternating Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: The classic dumbbell curl, one arm at a time. Keep your elbow by your side, curl the weight up while turning your palm up, squeeze at the top and lower under control before switching arms.

exercises.name: American Football
exercises.instructions: A contact team sport of short, explosive efforts: sprints, cuts, blocks and tackles. Builds power, speed and agility.

exercises.name: American Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: A kettlebell swing that finishes overhead instead of at chest height. Hinge back, then snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to arm's length overhead, keeping your ribs down and your core tight.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: An advanced one-sided pull-up. With a wide grip, pull your chin toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight, then lower and switch sides. A step toward the one-arm pull-up.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A one-sided push-up. With your hands wide, lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, then press back up and switch sides. A step toward the one-arm push-up.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: A simple shoulder warm-up. Hold your arms straight out to the sides and draw circles, small to large, forward and then backward.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A shoulder press with a twist, made famous by Arnold Schwarzenegger. Start with palms facing you at chin height, then press overhead while rotating your palms forward; reverse it on the way down. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A shoulder press with a twist, made famous by Arnold Schwarzenegger. Start with palms facing you at chin height, then press overhead while rotating your palms forward; reverse it on the way down. A kettlebell's offset weight adds a grip and stability challenge.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
exercises.instructions: An air bike that works your arms and legs together; the harder you push, the more it resists. Ideal for all-out intervals and steady conditioning.

exercises.name: Assisted Chin-Up (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A chin-up with a counterweight lifting part of your body weight, to build up to full chin-ups. Use an underhand, shoulder-width grip and pull until your chin clears the bar.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Band)
exercises.instructions: A dip with help lifting part of your body weight, to build up to full dips. Lower until your upper arms are about level with the floor, then press back up. Loop a band over the bars and kneel in it. It helps most at the bottom, where you need it; use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A dip with help lifting part of your body weight, to build up to full dips. Lower until your upper arms are about level with the floor, then press back up. Kneel on the pad; more counterweight means more help, so use less as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Band)
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with part of your body weight supported, to build up to full pull-ups. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down, then lower all the way. Loop a band over the bar and put a knee or foot in it. It helps most at the bottom, where you need it; use a thinner band as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with part of your body weight supported, to build up to full pull-ups. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down, then lower all the way. Kneel or stand on the pad; more counterweight means more help, so use less as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Atlas Stone Lift
exercises.instructions: A strongman lift: pick up a heavy round stone and load it onto a platform. Lap the stone, wrap your arms around it, then extend your hips hard to roll it up and over.

exercises.name: Axle Deadlift
exercises.instructions: A deadlift with a thick, non-rotating axle that tests your grip. Set up as for a normal deadlift and pull with a double overhand or mixed grip.

exercises.name: Axle Press
exercises.instructions: An overhead press with a thick strongman axle. Clean it to your shoulders, then press it overhead, using a little leg drive if you need it.

exercises.name: B-Skip
exercises.instructions: A running drill that builds on the A-skip: drive the knee up, extend the leg forward, then sweep it back down to strike under your hips.

exercises.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A hip thrust with most of the load on one leg while the other foot rests lightly in front as a kickstand. Drive through the working heel and lock your hips out at the top.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings. With your hips on the pad of a back extension bench, lower your torso toward the floor, then raise it until your body forms a straight line.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Machine)
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings. With your hips on the pad of a back extension bench, lower your torso toward the floor, then raise it until your body forms a straight line. Seated on the machine, push back against the pad by extending your hips and spine.

exercises.name: Back Lever
exercises.instructions: An advanced gymnastics hold: hang from a bar or rings face down with your body straight and level with the floor. Build up through tuck and straddle versions.

exercises.name: Backstroke
exercises.instructions: A swimming stroke on your back: alternate overarm strokes with a steady flutter kick while keeping your hips high. Easy on the neck and good for posture.

exercises.name: Backward Sled Drag
exercises.instructions: Walk backward pulling a sled with a strap or handles. Builds the quads and knees with very little stress on the joints.

exercises.name: Badminton
exercises.instructions: A fast racket sport of quick lunges, jumps and overhead smashes. Builds agility, reflexes and conditioning.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions: A band exercise for the rear shoulders and upper back. Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Banded Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with a band across your back, held under your hands, so the top of each rep gets harder.

exercises.name: Bar-Facing Burpee
exercises.instructions: A burpee done beside a barbell: chest to the floor, then jump over the bar with both feet and repeat facing the other way.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.instructions: An ab rollout with a loaded barbell in place of an ab wheel. Kneel, roll the bar forward while keeping your back flat, then pull it back with your abs.

exercises.name: Barre
exercises.instructions: A low-impact class blending ballet, Pilates and yoga: small, precise movements at a barre that build strength, posture and balance.

exercises.name: Baseball
exercises.instructions: A bat-and-ball sport of sprints, throws and powerful rotational swings.

exercises.name: Basketball
exercises.instructions: A fast team sport of sprints, jumps and quick changes of direction. Great for conditioning and agility.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Slams
exercises.instructions: A full-body power and conditioning move. Lift both battle ropes overhead, then slam them into the ground as hard as you can, again and again.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Waves
exercises.instructions: Hard conditioning for the shoulders and core. Hold the ends of the ropes in a half squat and whip them in fast waves, alternating arms or both together.

exercises.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A cable curl with your back to the pulley, so your arm starts behind you and the biceps work from a deep stretch. Curl forward and up while keeping your elbow back.

exercises.name: Beach Volleyball
exercises.instructions: Volleyball on sand, where every jump and sprint takes extra effort. Great for the legs and conditioning.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.instructions: A crawl on hands and feet with your knees hovering just off the floor. Keep your back flat and move the opposite hand and foot together.

exercises.name: Bear Hug Squat (Sandbag)
exercises.instructions: A squat hugging a sandbag against your chest. The awkward load works your upper back and core hard along with your legs.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A shrug with the bar held behind your thighs, which shifts more of the work to the middle of your traps. Lift your shoulders straight up, pause, and lower.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A forearm curl with the bar behind your back, palms facing back. Let the bar roll down to your fingertips, then curl it up with your wrists.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: A lat pulldown bringing the bar behind your head. It needs good shoulder mobility, so keep the range comfortable and the weight moderate.

exercises.name: Behind-the-Neck Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: An overhead press from behind the head that hits the side and rear shoulders. Only use it if your shoulders are mobile enough, and keep the weight moderate.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A squat with the load hung from a belt around your hips, training your legs hard without loading your spine.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.instructions: A triceps exercise with your hands on a bench behind you. Lower until your elbows bend to about 90°, then press back up; bend your knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Band)
exercises.instructions: The classic upper-body press for the chest, front shoulders and triceps. Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, lower the weight to your mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body, then press back up. Wrap the band behind your back and press it out, lying or standing.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: The classic upper-body press for the chest, front shoulders and triceps. Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, lower the weight to your mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body, then press back up. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Cable)
exercises.instructions: The classic upper-body press for the chest, front shoulders and triceps. Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, lower the weight to your mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body, then press back up. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: The classic upper-body press for the chest, front shoulders and triceps. Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, lower the weight to your mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body, then press back up. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: The classic upper-body press for the chest, front shoulders and triceps. Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, lower the weight to your mid-chest with elbows about 45° from your body, then press back up. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A horizontal pull for the upper back and lats. Hinge forward with a flat back, then row the weight to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A horizontal pull for the upper back and lats. Hinge forward with a flat back, then row the weight to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A horizontal pull for the upper back and lats. Hinge forward with a flat back, then row the weight to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Band)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. The band gets harder as it stretches, so the end of each rep is the toughest.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (EZ Bar)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. The EZ bar's angled grips are easier on the wrists and elbows.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. A kettlebell's offset weight adds a grip and stability challenge.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
exercises.instructions: The classic arm builder for the biceps. Keep your elbows at your sides, curl the weight up without swinging, squeeze at the top and lower slowly. The machine guides the movement, so you can focus on the working muscle.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.instructions: A twisting crunch for the abs and obliques. Lying on your back, bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while straightening the other leg, then switch sides in a pedaling motion.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instructions: A core stability exercise on hands and knees. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level, keeping your hips square, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Board Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press that stops on a board resting on your chest, overloading the top half of the press and the triceps.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: The foundation of every squat. Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, sit your hips back and down until your thighs are level with the floor, keeping your chest up and heels down, then stand.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: A triceps exercise using a bar or bench at about waist height. Lean in with straight arms, bend your elbows to lower your head below your hands, then straighten your arms to push back up.

exercises.name: Bottoms-Up Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: An overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, bell on top. Keeping it balanced trains your grip and shoulder stability.

exercises.name: Bouldering
exercises.instructions: Climbing short routes without ropes, over crash pads. Builds grip, pulling strength and problem-solving.

exercises.name: Bounding
exercises.instructions: Exaggerated running strides, pushing off hard to cover as much ground as possible with each step. Builds leg power and speed.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.instructions: Builds explosive leg power. Jump onto a sturdy box from both feet, land softly in a quarter squat, stand tall, then step back down.

exercises.name: Box Jump Over
exercises.instructions: A conditioning favorite: jump onto the box and off the other side (or step over it), then turn around and repeat.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat to a box that teaches depth and a hips-back squat. Sit back until you touch the box, pause briefly without relaxing, then drive up.

exercises.name: Boxing
exercises.instructions: Punching combinations, footwork and defense, on a bag or with a partner. Superb conditioning for the whole body.

exercises.name: Bradford Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A shoulder press where the bar travels just over your head, front to back and back again, keeping constant tension on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
exercises.instructions: A grappling martial art built around ground control and submissions. Builds strength, endurance and body awareness.

exercises.name: Breaststroke
exercises.instructions: A swimming stroke with a frog-like kick and a sweeping arm pull, gliding between strokes. Works the chest, legs and hips.

exercises.name: Bridge Hold
exercises.instructions: Hold the top of a glute bridge: shoulders on the floor and hips lifted in a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes the whole time.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.instructions: A standing long jump. Swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can, landing softly on both feet.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: A single-leg squat with your back foot up on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, keeping your torso tall, then drive up through your front heel.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A single-leg squat with your back foot up on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, keeping your torso tall, then drive up through your front heel. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A single-leg squat with your back foot up on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, keeping your torso tall, then drive up through your front heel. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, which keeps the weight low and easy to balance.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A single-leg squat with your back foot up on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, keeping your torso tall, then drive up through your front heel. Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, or one at your chest, goblet-style.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A single-leg squat with your back foot up on a bench. Lower until your front thigh is about level with the floor, keeping your torso tall, then drive up through your front heel. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: A full-body conditioning move. Squat down, jump your feet back to a push-up position, bring them back in, then jump up with your arms overhead.

exercises.name: Burpee Box Jump Over
exercises.instructions: A burpee followed by a jump onto or over a box. A punishing conditioning combination.

exercises.name: Burpee Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A burpee finished with a jump into a pull-up on an overhead bar.

exercises.name: Bus Driver (Plate)
exercises.instructions: Hold a weight plate at arm's length at shoulder height and turn it left and right like a steering wheel. Works the shoulders and forearms.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.instructions: A running drill: jog in place or forward, kicking your heels up toward your glutes with quick steps.

exercises.name: Butterfly Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A fast, cycling pull-up used in CrossFit, where your body moves in a continuous loop driven by your hips. Master strict pull-ups first.

exercises.name: Butterfly Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: A sit-up with the soles of your feet together and knees out wide. Reach overhead as you lie back, then sit up and reach for your feet.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.instructions: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and let your knees drop toward the floor, pressing them gently if you like.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stroke
exercises.instructions: The most demanding swimming stroke: both arms sweep over the water together, driven by an undulating dolphin kick.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: A cable fly for the chest. With the pulleys set high, step forward and bring the handles together in front of you in a wide arc, squeezing your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel below a high pulley holding a rope by your head, then crunch your ribs down toward your hips by rounding your spine. Keep your hips still.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.instructions: A hip hinge for the glutes and hamstrings. Face away from a low pulley holding a rope between your legs, hinge back, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: California Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A triceps press that blends a close-grip bench press and a skull crusher: lower the bar toward your upper chest while your elbows drift forward, then press up.

exercises.name: Canoeing
exercises.instructions: Paddling a canoe with a single-bladed paddle. Works the back, shoulders and core.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: With your forearms on the pads of a captain's chair, raise your knees (or straight legs) toward your chest by curling your pelvis up. Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Car Deadlift
exercises.instructions: A strongman deadlift that lifts a car frame by its handles. Heavy, grip-intensive, and usually a partial range of motion.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.instructions: A gentle flow for spine mobility on hands and knees. Round your back up like a cat, then let it sag as you lift your head and tailbone. Move with your breath.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions: A dip that leans forward to work the chest. On parallel bars, lower with your torso tilted forward until your shoulders are just below your elbows, then press up.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Band)
exercises.instructions: An isolation exercise for the chest. With a soft bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then hug them back together. The band gets harder as it stretches, so the end of each rep is the toughest.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.instructions: An isolation exercise for the chest. With a soft bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then hug them back together. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: An isolation exercise for the chest. With a soft bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then hug them back together. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.instructions: An isolation exercise for the chest. With a soft bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then hug them back together. Often called the pec deck.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Suspension)
exercises.instructions: An isolation exercise for the chest. With a soft bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a stretch, then hug them back together. Face away from the anchor and lean into the straps; the lower your body angle, the harder it gets.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Band)
exercises.instructions: A press for the chest, shoulders and triceps. Press the handles forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Wrap the band behind your back, or anchor it behind you, and press forward.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A press for the chest, shoulders and triceps. Press the handles forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. The machine guides the movement, so you can focus on the working muscle.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A row with your chest resting on an incline bench or pad, which takes the lower back out of it. Row toward your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A row with your chest resting on an incline bench or pad, which takes the lower back out of it. Row toward your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together. The machine guides the movement, so you can focus on the working muscle.

exercises.name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up taken high enough to touch your chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.instructions: A resting stretch for the back and hips. Kneel, sit back on your heels and fold forward with your arms stretched out in front and your forehead toward the floor.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with an underhand, shoulder-width grip that brings in more biceps. From a straight-arm hang, pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

exercises.name: Circuit Training
exercises.instructions: A series of exercises done back to back with little rest, building strength and conditioning in one session.

exercises.name: Circus Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: A strongman press with a single thick-handled dumbbell: clean it to your shoulder, then press it overhead with one arm.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.instructions: Targets the side of the glutes. Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together, then open your top knee like a clamshell without rolling your hips back.

exercises.name: Clamshell (Band)
exercises.instructions: Targets the side of the glutes. Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together, then open your top knee like a clamshell without rolling your hips back. Loop a band just above your knees.

exercises.name: Clap Push-Up
exercises.instructions: An explosive push-up. Push up hard enough for your hands to leave the floor, clap, and land softly with bent elbows.

exercises.name: Clapping Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: An explosive pull-up. Pull hard enough to let go of the bar at the top, clap, and catch it again.

exercises.name: Clean (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: An Olympic lift that brings the weight from the floor to your shoulders in one explosive move. Pull, extend your hips hard, then drop under it into a front rack. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Clean (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: An Olympic lift that brings the weight from the floor to your shoulders in one explosive move. Pull, extend your hips hard, then drop under it into a front rack. With dumbbells, each arm works on its own and the lift is easier to learn.

exercises.name: Clean (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: An Olympic lift that brings the weight from the floor to your shoulders in one explosive move. Pull, extend your hips hard, then drop under it into a front rack. The kettlebell rolls around your hand into the rack; keep it close so it doesn't bang your forearm.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: The Olympic lift that takes the weight from the floor to overhead in two parts: clean it to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: The Olympic lift that takes the weight from the floor to overhead in two parts: clean it to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. With dumbbells, each arm works on its own and the lift is easier to learn.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: The Olympic lift that takes the weight from the floor to overhead in two parts: clean it to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. The kettlebell rolls around your hand into the rack; keep it close so it doesn't bang your forearm.

exercises.name: Clean and Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Clean the weight from the floor to your shoulders, then press it overhead, strictly or with a little leg drive. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Clean and Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Clean the weight from the floor to your shoulders, then press it overhead, strictly or with a little leg drive. The kettlebell rolls around your hand into the rack; keep it close so it doesn't bang your forearm.

exercises.name: Clean Pull (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: The first part of a clean. Pull the bar from the floor and extend explosively onto your toes with a shrug, without dropping under it.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press with hands about shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked in, which shifts more of the work to the triceps. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press with hands about shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked in, which shifts more of the work to the triceps. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A bench press with hands about shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked in, which shifts more of the work to the triceps. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: A lat pulldown with a narrow, palms-facing grip (a V-handle), pulling the handle to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Cluster (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A clean straight into a thruster: clean the weight to your shoulders, squat down, and drive up while pressing it overhead. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Cluster (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A clean straight into a thruster: clean the weight to your shoulders, squat down, and drive up while pressing it overhead. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.instructions: A back-bending stretch for the abs and hip flexors. Lie face down and press your chest up with your arms, keeping your hips on the floor.

exercises.name: Cold Plunge
exercises.instructions: Brief immersion in cold water for recovery. Start with short dips and keep your breathing slow and calm.

exercises.name: Commando Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with your hands close together, one in front of the other, pulling your head to alternating sides of the bar.

exercises.name: Conan's Wheel
exercises.instructions: A strongman event: carry the weighted end of a lever arm as far around its circle as you can.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced against your inner thigh, for strict biceps work with no swinging.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.instructions: A side plank with your top leg resting on a bench, which works the inner thighs hard. Start with the knee on the bench, then progress to the foot.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.instructions: A deep side-to-side squat. Shift your weight into one leg while the other stays straight with its toes up. Builds hip mobility and strength.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A deep side-to-side squat. Shift your weight into one leg while the other stays straight with its toes up. Builds hip mobility and strength. Hold one dumbbell at your chest, goblet-style, to help you sit deeper.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A deep side-to-side squat. Shift your weight into one leg while the other stays straight with its toes up. Builds hip mobility and strength. Hold the kettlebell at your chest, goblet-style, to help you sit deeper.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.instructions: A deep stretch for the hip flexors and quads. Kneel with your back shin up against a wall or couch, front foot planted, and lift your torso tall.

exercises.name: Cricket
exercises.instructions: A bat-and-ball sport of sprints between the wickets, bowling and batting.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A hammer curl across your body toward the opposite shoulder, for the brachialis and forearms.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.instructions: Pull one straight arm across your chest with the other hand to stretch the back of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A one-arm cable extension across your body from the opposite side, for the triceps.

exercises.name: Cross-Country Skiing
exercises.instructions: Skiing across flat and rolling terrain with poles. One of the best full-body endurance sports.

exercises.name: Crow Pose
exercises.instructions: A yoga arm balance. With your hands on the floor, rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms and tip forward until your feet lift.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: The classic ab exercise. Lie on your back with knees bent and curl your shoulders off the floor toward your hips, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cuban Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A shoulder-health exercise: an upright row to elbows at shoulder height, rotate your forearms up, then press overhead. Use light weights.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.instructions: A lunge that steps one leg diagonally behind the other, like a curtsy, to work the glutes and outer hips.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A lunge that steps one leg diagonally behind the other, like a curtsy, to work the glutes and outer hips. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, which keeps the weight low and easy to balance.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.instructions: Riding a bike outdoors: low-impact cardio that builds leg endurance.

exercises.name: Dancing
exercises.instructions: Moving to music, from casual to choreographed. Great cardio and coordination.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: A core exercise on your back. With arms up and knees over hips, lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back pressed down, then switch.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and relaxed shoulders. Builds grip strength and gently decompresses the spine.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Band)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. Stand on the middle of the band and grip it like a bar; it gets harder as you stand up.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides or in front of your thighs.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. Stand over the kettlebell so it sits between your feet, and grip the handle with both hands.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Trap Bar)
exercises.instructions: A full-body pull from the floor for the glutes, hamstrings and back. Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the weight, then stand up by driving through your legs and hips. The trap bar keeps the load in line with your body, which is easier on the lower back.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on a decline bench, head lower than hips, which emphasizes the lower chest. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on a decline bench, head lower than hips, which emphasizes the lower chest. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on a decline bench, head lower than hips, which emphasizes the lower chest. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A chest fly on a decline bench, for the lower chest. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A chest fly on a decline bench, for the lower chest. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine press with a downward pressing path, emphasizing the lower chest.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.instructions: A crunch on a decline bench with your feet hooked, for more range and difficulty.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting the emphasis to the upper chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: A sit-up on a decline bench with your feet anchored, lifting your whole torso up.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.instructions: Sit in the bottom of a squat, heels down and chest up, and relax into it. Builds hip and ankle mobility.

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A deadlift standing on a low platform, which lengthens the pull and builds strength off the floor.

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with your hands on raised handles or plates so your chest can drop lower, for more range.

exercises.name: Depth Jump
exercises.instructions: An advanced plyometric. Step off a box, land, and immediately jump as high as you can, spending as little time on the ground as possible.

exercises.name: Devil Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A burpee with a dumbbell in each hand, finishing with a swing of both dumbbells from the floor to overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with your hands together under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond, which targets the triceps.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A calf raise bent forward at the hips with the load on your hips, which stretches the calves more.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, kick one bent leg up behind you until your thigh is level, squeezing the glute at the top.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.instructions: Place your forearm on a door frame at shoulder height and step through gently to stretch the chest and front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Double-Under
exercises.instructions: A jump rope skill where the rope passes under your feet twice on each jump. Jump a little higher and spin the rope fast with your wrists.

exercises.name: Downhill Skiing
exercises.instructions: Skiing down slopes. Builds leg strength, balance and endurance.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.instructions: A yoga pose that forms an upside-down V. With hands and feet on the floor and hips high, press your heels toward the floor to stretch the hamstrings and calves.

exercises.name: Drag Curl (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A curl where the bar slides up along your torso as your elbows travel back, emphasizing the long head of the biceps.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.instructions: An advanced core move. Lying on a bench and gripping it behind your head, raise your body onto your shoulders and lower it slowly as one rigid line.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.instructions: A low-impact cardio machine with a smooth, gliding stride; use the handles to work your arms too.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Band)
exercises.instructions: A rotator cuff exercise for healthy shoulders. With your elbow bent to 90° and tucked at your side, rotate your forearm outward, then return slowly. Keep it light. Anchor the band at elbow height.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A rotator cuff exercise for healthy shoulders. With your elbow bent to 90° and tucked at your side, rotate your forearm outward, then return slowly. Keep it light. Set the pulley at elbow height.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A rotator cuff exercise for healthy shoulders. With your elbow bent to 90° and tucked at your side, rotate your forearm outward, then return slowly. Keep it light. Lie on your side with the dumbbell in your top hand and your elbow on your hip.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Band)
exercises.instructions: A pull for the rear shoulders and upper back that keeps shoulders healthy. Pull a rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide, then rotate your hands back so your knuckles point up. Anchor the band at face height.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A pull for the rear shoulders and upper back that keeps shoulders healthy. Pull a rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide, then rotate your hands back so your knuckles point up. Set the pulley at head height or a little above and use a rope.

exercises.name: Farmer's Hold (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding heavy weights at your sides for time. Builds grip, forearms, traps and core. Dumbbells are the easiest way to start; hold them by the middle of the handle.

exercises.name: Farmer's Hold (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding heavy weights at your sides for time. Builds grip, forearms, traps and core. Kettlebells hang close to your legs, which makes them comfortable to hold.

exercises.name: Farmer's Hold (Trap Bar)
exercises.instructions: Stand tall holding heavy weights at your sides for time. Builds grip, forearms, traps and core. The trap bar balances the load in both hands, so you can hold it heaviest.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Walk with a heavy weight in each hand at your sides. Stand tall, brace your core and take short, quick steps. Builds grip, traps, core and conditioning. Dumbbells are the easiest way to start; hold them by the middle of the handle.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Handles)
exercises.instructions: Walk with a heavy weight in each hand at your sides. Stand tall, brace your core and take short, quick steps. Builds grip, traps, core and conditioning. Farmer's handles let you load them heavy with a neutral grip.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Walk with a heavy weight in each hand at your sides. Stand tall, brace your core and take short, quick steps. Builds grip, traps, core and conditioning. Kettlebells hang close to your legs, which makes them comfortable to carry.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk (Trap Bar)
exercises.instructions: Walk with a heavy weight in each hand at your sides. Stand tall, brace your core and take short, quick steps. Builds grip, traps, core and conditioning. The trap bar balances the load in both hands, so you can carry it heaviest.

exercises.name: Fencing
exercises.instructions: A combat sport with foil, épée or sabre, built on quick footwork, lunges and reactions.

exercises.name: Field Hockey
exercises.instructions: A fast team sport played with sticks on grass or turf, full of sprints and changes of direction.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Stretch
exercises.instructions: A stretch for the glutes and outer hip. Lying on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull that thigh toward your chest.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg out to the side without tilting your hips, then lower it. Targets the side glutes.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A press lying on the floor, which stops your elbows at the floor and limits the range. Great for triceps and lockout strength, and easy on the shoulders. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A press lying on the floor, which stops your elbows at the floor and limits the range. Great for triceps and lockout strength, and easy on the shoulders. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A press lying on the floor, which stops your elbows at the floor and limits the range. Great for triceps and lockout strength, and easy on the shoulders. A kettlebell's offset weight adds a grip and stability challenge.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and just off the floor, then kick them up and down in small, quick alternating strokes. Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Adductors
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with one leg bent out to the side and the roller under your inner thigh, then roll slowly from knee to hip, pausing on tight spots.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Calves
exercises.instructions: Sit with the roller under your calves, lift your hips and roll from ankle to knee. Cross one leg over the other for more pressure.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Chest
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with the roller angled under one side of your chest near the shoulder, and roll gently in small movements.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Glutes
exercises.instructions: Sit on the roller, cross one ankle over the opposite knee and lean into that glute, rolling slowly over tight spots.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Hamstrings
exercises.instructions: Sit with the roller under your thighs and roll from just above the knees to the bottom of your glutes.

exercises.name: Foam Roll IT Band
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your outer thigh and roll slowly between hip and knee, easing pressure with your top leg.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Lats
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit, arm stretched overhead, and roll down along the side of your back.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Quads
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with the roller under your thighs and roll from hip to just above the knee.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Upper Back
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back, hands behind your head, and roll between your shoulder blades. Avoid the lower back.

exercises.name: Frame Carry
exercises.instructions: A strongman carry with a heavy frame held at your sides. Walk tall with quick steps and a braced core.

exercises.name: Frog Jump
exercises.instructions: From a deep squat with hands near the floor, leap forward as far as you can and land back in the squat.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
exercises.instructions: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees out, done for high reps to pump the glutes.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
exercises.instructions: A deep stretch for the inner thighs. On hands and knees, slide your knees wide apart, keep your shins parallel, and rock your hips back.

exercises.name: Front Lever
exercises.instructions: An advanced gymnastics hold: hang from a bar or rings face up with your body straight and level with the floor. Build up through tuck and straddle versions.

exercises.name: Front Lever Raise
exercises.instructions: Lift your straight body from a hang up into a front lever position and lower slowly. Builds lat and core strength for the full lever.

exercises.name: Front Rack Carry (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Walk with kettlebells held in the front rack at your shoulders. Challenges your core and upper back to keep you tall.

exercises.name: Front Rack Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A lunge with a barbell held across the front of your shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and works the quads hard.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Band)
exercises.instructions: Lifts the front of the shoulders. With straight arms, raise the weight in front of you to shoulder height, pause, and lower slowly without swinging. The band gets harder as it stretches, so the end of each rep is the toughest.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Lifts the front of the shoulders. With straight arms, raise the weight in front of you to shoulder height, pause, and lower slowly without swinging. Hold the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and raise it as one.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Lifts the front of the shoulders. With straight arms, raise the weight in front of you to shoulder height, pause, and lower slowly without swinging. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Lifts the front of the shoulders. With straight arms, raise the weight in front of you to shoulder height, pause, and lower slowly without swinging. Raise both together or alternate arms.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Plate)
exercises.instructions: Lifts the front of the shoulders. With straight arms, raise the weight in front of you to shoulder height, pause, and lower slowly without swinging. Hold a plate by its edges, at 3 and 9 o'clock.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat with the weight held at the front of your shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and focuses on the quads and core. Keep your elbows high. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat with the weight held at the front of your shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and focuses on the quads and core. Keep your elbows high. Rest a dumbbell on each shoulder, elbows up.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A squat with the weight held at the front of your shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and focuses on the quads and core. Keep your elbows high. Hold the kettlebells in the rack position, resting on your forearms.

exercises.name: German Hang
exercises.instructions: A shoulder mobility hang: from a bar or rings, rotate your body back and down so you hang behind your hands with your shoulders fully extended. Ease into it.

exercises.name: GHD Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: A sit-up on a glute-ham developer, lowering back past parallel and sitting up hard. Very intense; build up slowly.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the glutes and hamstrings. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until they line up with your knees and shoulders.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Band)
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the glutes and hamstrings. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until they line up with your knees and shoulders. Loop a band just above your knees and push them out as you lift.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the glutes and hamstrings. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until they line up with your knees and shoulders. Roll the bar over your hips and use a pad for comfort.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Strengthens the glutes and hamstrings. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, then drive through your heels to lift your hips until they line up with your knees and shoulders. Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady with both hands.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Band)
exercises.instructions: Kick one leg straight back behind you from the hip, squeezing the glute at the end, without arching your lower back. Loop the band around your foot and anchor it low in front of you.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Kick one leg straight back behind you from the hip, squeezing the glute at the end, without arching your lower back. Strap an ankle cuff to the low pulley.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
exercises.instructions: Kick one leg straight back behind you from the hip, squeezing the glute at the end, without arching your lower back. The machine guides the movement, so you can focus on the working muscle.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: A hamstring exercise on a glute-ham bench. From upright on your knees, lower your torso forward, then curl yourself back up using your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat holding one weight at your chest, which keeps you upright and teaches great form. Sit between your heels, elbows inside your knees, then stand. Hold the dumbbell upright by one end, cupped in both hands.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A squat holding one weight at your chest, which keeps you upright and teaches great form. Sit between your heels, elbows inside your knees, then stand. Hold the kettlebell by its horns, close to your chest.

exercises.name: Golf
exercises.instructions: Walking the course and swinging clubs. Builds rotational power, balance and steady endurance.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Band)
exercises.instructions: A hip hinge for the hamstrings and lower back. With the load across your upper back and knees slightly bent, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then stand. Stand on the band with it looped behind your neck; it gets harder as you stand up.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A hip hinge for the hamstrings and lower back. With the load across your upper back and knees slightly bent, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then stand. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A hip hinge for the hamstrings and lower back. With the load across your upper back and knees slightly bent, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then stand. Hold a dumbbell against your chest with both hands.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A hip hinge for the hamstrings and lower back. With the load across your upper back and knees slightly bent, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then stand. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Row two kettlebells from the floor in a wide stance, alternating arms while the other kettlebell stays down. Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Ground to Overhead (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Move the weight from the floor to overhead any way you like, a clean and jerk or a snatch. A CrossFit staple for conditioning. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Ground to Overhead (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Move the weight from the floor to overhead any way you like, a clean and jerk or a snatch. A CrossFit staple for conditioning. Often done with one dumbbell, switching hands each rep.

exercises.name: Ground to Overhead (Plate)
exercises.instructions: Move the weight from the floor to overhead any way you like, a clean and jerk or a snatch. A CrossFit staple for conditioning. Grab a bumper plate by its edges and bring it overhead.

exercises.name: Guillotine Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press lowering the bar to your neck with elbows wide, to stretch the chest. Use light weight and a spotter.

exercises.name: Gymnastics
exercises.instructions: Strength, balance and flexibility skills on the floor and apparatus. Builds remarkable body control.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat on a sled machine with your back supported, or with a barbell held behind your legs. Emphasizes the quads. Hold the bar behind your legs, just below your glutes, and stand up with it.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A squat on a sled machine with your back supported, or with a barbell held behind your legs. Emphasizes the quads. Set your back and shoulders against the pads and keep your feet flat on the platform.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Kneel on one knee and press the end of a landmine bar up and forward with the arm on the side of the down knee. Keeps you honest through the core.

exercises.name: Halo (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Circle a kettlebell around your head, held upside down by the horns, keeping it close. Great for shoulder mobility and core control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Band)
exercises.instructions: A curl with palms facing each other, which works the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps. The band gets harder as it stretches, so the end of each rep is the toughest.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A curl with palms facing each other, which works the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps. Use a rope attachment.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A curl with palms facing each other, which works the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Hand Gripper
exercises.instructions: Squeeze a spring-loaded gripper closed, hold, and release slowly. Builds crushing grip strength.

exercises.name: Hand-Release Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up where you lower your chest to the floor and lift your hands briefly before pressing up, which makes every rep full range.

exercises.name: Handball
exercises.instructions: A fast indoor team sport of running, jumping and throwing.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
exercises.instructions: Balance upside down on your hands, against a wall or free-standing. Builds shoulder strength and balance.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.instructions: An inverted press in a handstand: lower your head to the floor and press back up. Start against a wall.

exercises.name: Handstand Walk
exercises.instructions: Walk forward on your hands while balancing in a handstand.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A clean that starts from a hang just above the knees rather than the floor: extend your hips explosively and receive the weight at your shoulders. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Hang Clean (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A clean that starts from a hang just above the knees rather than the floor: extend your hips explosively and receive the weight at your shoulders. With dumbbells, each arm works on its own and the lift is easier to learn.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A hang clean caught in a partial squat above parallel. Great for explosive hip power.

exercises.name: Hang Power Snatch (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A snatch from the hang, caught overhead in a partial squat above parallel.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A snatch from a hang above the knees, pulled explosively and caught overhead in a full squat.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise your straight legs to hip height or higher by curling your pelvis up, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Happy Baby
exercises.instructions: A relaxing hip stretch. Lie on your back, bring your knees toward your armpits and hold the outsides of your feet, gently rocking side to side.

exercises.name: Headstand
exercises.instructions: Balance upside down on your forearms and the top of your head, with a straight line from shoulders to feet. Learn it against a wall.

exercises.name: Heavy Bag
exercises.instructions: Punching and kicking a heavy bag in rounds. Great conditioning and power work.

exercises.name: Heel Touch
exercises.instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, reach side to side to touch each heel, crunching through your obliques.

exercises.name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A goblet squat with your heels raised on a plate or wedge, which lets you sink deeper and hits the quads more.

exercises.name: Helms Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A strict dumbbell row with your chest against an incline bench, focused on the upper back with no body English.

exercises.name: High Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: A curl with the pulleys set high and arms out to the sides, like a double-biceps pose. Curl the handles toward your head.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, driving your knees up to hip height with quick steps and pumping arms.

exercises.name: High Pull (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: An explosive pull from the hang or floor: extend your hips and pull the bar up to chest height with your elbows high.

exercises.name: High Row (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine row pulling down and back from a high angle, working the lats and upper back.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
exercises.instructions: A cable fly from high pulleys, bringing the handles down and together in front of your hips to target the lower chest.

exercises.name: HIIT
exercises.instructions: High-intensity interval training: short, all-out bursts with brief rests. Maximum conditioning in minimal time.

exercises.name: Hiking
exercises.instructions: Walking on trails and hills. Steady cardio that builds leg strength and endurance.

exercises.name: Hill Sprint
exercises.instructions: Short, all-out sprints up a hill, walking back down to recover. Builds speed, power and conditioning with less impact than flat sprints.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A flowing push-up from downward dog: swoop your chest down between your hands and up into a cobra, then push back.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Band)
exercises.instructions: Moves your leg out to the side against resistance, working the side glutes (abductors). Loop a band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Moves your leg out to the side against resistance, working the side glutes (abductors). Strap an ankle cuff to the low pulley and stand side-on to the stack.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.instructions: Moves your leg out to the side against resistance, working the side glutes (abductors). Sit with your legs against the pads and push them apart.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Brings your leg in toward your body's midline against resistance, working the inner thighs (adductors). Strap an ankle cuff to the low pulley and stand side-on to the stack.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
exercises.instructions: Brings your leg in toward your body's midline against resistance, working the inner thighs (adductors). Sit with your legs against the pads and squeeze them together.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg and draw big circles with the other knee, opening and closing the hip. A good warm-up.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Band)
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower. Loop a band just above your knees and push them out as you lift.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower. Roll the bar over your hips and use a pad for comfort.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower. Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady with both hands.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower. The machine guides the movement, so you can focus on the working muscle.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: The top glute builder. With your upper back on a bench and feet flat, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeeze, and lower. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.instructions: A foundational gymnastics core hold. Lie on your back, press your lower back down, and lift your shoulders and straight legs just off the floor, arms overhead.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock
exercises.instructions: Rock back and forth in a hollow body hold, keeping the rigid, curved shape.

exercises.name: Horizontal Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A seated leg press pushing the platform straight out in front, working the quads and glutes.

exercises.name: Horseback Riding
exercises.instructions: Riding a horse works balance, posture and the inner thighs and core.

exercises.name: Human Flag
exercises.instructions: An advanced calisthenics hold: grip a vertical pole and hold your body out sideways, level with the floor.

exercises.name: Hurdle Hop
exercises.instructions: Jump over a series of low hurdles with both feet, spending as little time on the ground as possible between jumps.

exercises.name: Husafell Stone Carry
exercises.instructions: A strongman carry: hug a heavy, flat-sided stone against your chest and walk as far as you can.

exercises.name: Ice Hockey
exercises.instructions: A fast skating team sport of sprints, stops and physical play.

exercises.name: Ice Skating
exercises.instructions: Gliding on ice. Builds leg strength, balance and endurance.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on an incline bench, which emphasizes the upper chest and front shoulders. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on an incline bench, which emphasizes the upper chest and front shoulders. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: A bench press on an incline bench, which emphasizes the upper chest and front shoulders. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A chest fly on an incline bench, for the upper chest. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A chest fly on an incline bench, for the upper chest. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine press at an upward angle, emphasizing the upper chest.

exercises.name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A dumbbell curl lying back on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down, which stretches the biceps' long head.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with your hands raised on a bench or box, making it easier. A great way to build up to full push-ups.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.instructions: Walking on a steep treadmill incline at a steady pace. Low-impact cardio that works the legs and glutes.

exercises.name: Inline Skating
exercises.instructions: Rollerblading: smooth, low-impact cardio that builds the legs and glutes.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation (Band)
exercises.instructions: A rotator cuff exercise. With your elbow bent 90° and tucked at your side, rotate your forearm in across your body against light resistance. Anchor the band at elbow height.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A rotator cuff exercise. With your elbow bent 90° and tucked at your side, rotate your forearm in across your body against light resistance. Set the pulley at elbow height.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: A bodyweight row for the upper back. Hang under a bar set at waist height with your body straight and heels down, then pull your chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A plate-loaded machine press with independent arms, so each side works on its own.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Incline Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: An incline machine press with independent arms, for the upper chest one side at a time.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Lat Pulldown (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine pulldown with independent arms, letting each lat work on its own.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A plate-loaded machine row with independent arms, for the upper back one side at a time.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Shoulder Press (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine shoulder press with independent arms, so each side presses on its own.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: Lying flat with arms overhead, lift your arms and straight legs at the same time to meet over your hips, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A slow spinal flexion drill with a light weight. Standing on a box, roll down one vertebra at a time toward your toes, then roll back up. Start very light. Let the bar hang from straight arms as you roll down.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A slow spinal flexion drill with a light weight. Standing on a box, roll down one vertebra at a time toward your toes, then roll back up. Start very light. Hold a dumbbell in both hands and let it hang as you roll down.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: A slow spinal flexion drill with a light weight. Standing on a box, roll down one vertebra at a time toward your toes, then roll back up. Start very light. Hold the kettlebell by its handle in both hands and let it hang as you roll down.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A triceps press that blends a close-grip bench and a skull crusher: lower the bar toward your chin with elbows forward, then press up.

exercises.name: Judo
exercises.instructions: A grappling martial art of throws, pins and holds. Builds strength, balance and endurance.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.instructions: Skip rope with quick, light hops on the balls of your feet, turning the rope with your wrists. Great for conditioning and footwork.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.instructions: An explosive squat. Squat down, then jump as high as you can and land softly back into the next squat.

exercises.name: Jump Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: An explosive squat. Squat down, then jump as high as you can and land softly back into the next squat. Hold light dumbbells at your sides, light enough that you can still jump fast.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.instructions: Jump your feet out wide while raising your arms overhead, then jump back together. A classic warm-up and cardio move.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
exercises.instructions: Lunge down, then jump and switch legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge on the other side.

exercises.name: Jumping Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up where you jump to help yourself up, then lower slowly. Good for building toward strict pull-ups.

exercises.name: Karate
exercises.instructions: A striking martial art of punches, kicks and blocks. Builds speed, power and coordination.

exercises.name: Kayaking
exercises.instructions: Paddling a kayak with a double-bladed paddle. Works the back, shoulders and core.

exercises.name: Keg Carry
exercises.instructions: A strongman carry hugging a heavy keg against your chest or on your shoulder, walking as far as you can.

exercises.name: Keg Toss
exercises.instructions: A strongman event: swing a keg between your legs and throw it up and back over a bar using explosive hip drive.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions: An explosive hip hinge for the glutes and hamstrings. Hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to float it to chest height, arms relaxed.

exercises.name: Kickboxing
exercises.instructions: Punches and kicks in combinations, on pads, bags or with a partner. Great conditioning.

exercises.name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A handstand push-up that uses a leg kick to help you press up. Learn strict handstand push-ups first.

exercises.name: Kipping Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up that uses a hip swing to help you up. Efficient for high reps; learn strict pull-ups first.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up from your knees instead of your toes, which makes it easier. Keep a straight line from knees to head.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
exercises.instructions: Improves ankle bend. With one foot a few inches from a wall, drive your knee forward to touch the wall without lifting your heel, then move the foot back as you improve.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instructions: Kneel on one knee, tuck your pelvis under and shift forward gently to stretch the front of the hip on the kneeling side.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump
exercises.instructions: From kneeling, swing your arms and explode up onto your feet, landing in a squat. Builds hip power.

exercises.name: Knees-to-Elbows
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise your knees all the way up to touch your elbows, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Kroc Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A heavy, high-rep one-arm dumbbell row with a little body English, supported on a bench. Builds the back and grip.

exercises.name: L-Sit
exercises.instructions: Support yourself on straight arms (on parallettes, dip bars or the floor) with your legs straight out in front, level with the floor.

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with your legs held straight out in front in an L, adding a hard core challenge.

exercises.name: Lacrosse
exercises.instructions: A fast team sport played with long-handled sticks, full of sprints and changes of direction.

exercises.name: Lacrosse Ball Release
exercises.instructions: Self-massage with a lacrosse ball: press it into a tight muscle against the floor or a wall and roll slowly, pausing on tender spots.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions: Press the end of a landmine bar up and forward from your shoulder. The arcing path is easy on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar overhead with straight arms and rotate it in an arc from hip to hip, turning through your core.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.instructions: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest, which keeps you upright and balanced.

exercises.name: Landmine Squeeze Press
exercises.instructions: Press the end of a landmine bar with both hands squeezed together at your chest, for the inner chest.

exercises.name: Larsen Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press with your legs straight and off the floor, which takes away your leg drive and makes your upper body and core do all the work.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Band)
