exercises.instructions: A planche with your knees tucked to your chest, balancing on straight arms with your feet off the floor.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Stand up from lying on your back while holding a weight locked out overhead, then reverse the steps. Builds shoulder stability and total-body control. Keep your wrist straight and your knuckles pointing at the ceiling.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Stand up from lying on your back while holding a weight locked out overhead, then reverse the steps. Builds shoulder stability and total-body control. Keep the handle across your palm with a straight wrist and the bell resting on your forearm.

exercises.name: Typewriter Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Pull up with a wide grip, then slide side to side at the top toward each hand before lowering.

exercises.name: Ultimate Frisbee
exercises.instructions: A team sport of running, cutting and throwing a flying disc.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Upright Row (EZ Bar)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. The EZ bar's angled grips are easier on the wrists and elbows.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. Hold one kettlebell by the handle with both hands.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Smith Machine)
exercises.instructions: Works the side shoulders and traps. Pull the weight straight up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading and above your wrists, then lower slowly. The Smith machine fixes the bar's path for extra stability; set the safety stops before you start.

exercises.name: V-Sit Hold
exercises.instructions: Balance on your hips with your straight legs and torso raised into a V shape, and hold.

exercises.name: V-Squat (Machine)
exercises.instructions: A machine squat with your back against a pad that moves along an angled track, focusing on the quads.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.instructions: Lying flat with arms overhead, lift your straight arms and legs at the same time to touch your toes at the top of a V, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Viking Press (Landmine)
exercises.instructions: A two-handled landmine overhead press, pressing up and slightly forward with both arms.

exercises.name: Volleyball
exercises.instructions: A team sport of jumping, diving and quick reactions at the net.

exercises.name: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A curl holding one dumbbell vertically by its top plate with both hands cupped under it, like a waiter's tray.

exercises.name: Waiter Walk (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Walk holding a kettlebell locked out overhead in one hand, like a waiter's tray. Builds shoulder stability.

exercises.name: Walking
exercises.instructions: Low-impact cardio anyone can do: brisk walks build endurance and aid recovery.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Lunges that travel forward, stepping through into the next lunge with each rep. Great for the legs, glutes and balance.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Lunges that travel forward, stepping through into the next lunge with each rep. Great for the legs, glutes and balance. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Lunges that travel forward, stepping through into the next lunge with each rep. Great for the legs, glutes and balance. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, which keeps the weight low and easy to balance.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Lunges that travel forward, stepping through into the next lunge with each rep. Great for the legs, glutes and balance. Hold a kettlebell in each hand at your sides, or one at your chest, goblet-style.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.instructions: Squat holding a medicine ball at your chest, then drive up and throw it to a target high on the wall; catch it and go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.instructions: Slide down a wall until your thighs are level with the floor, knees over your ankles, and hold. Burns the quads.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and arms in a W against it, then slide your arms up overhead and back down while keeping contact. Improves shoulder mobility.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
exercises.instructions: From a push-up position with your feet against a wall, walk your feet up the wall and your hands in until you're nearly in a handstand, then walk back down.

exercises.name: Water Aerobics
exercises.instructions: Aerobic exercise in the pool, where the water adds resistance and takes the impact away.

exercises.name: Weighted Back Extension
exercises.instructions: A back extension holding a plate at your chest for extra resistance on the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: A chin-up with extra weight hung from a belt or held between your feet.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
exercises.instructions: A crunch holding a plate on your chest or behind your head for extra resistance.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.instructions: A dip with extra weight hung from a belt, for more chest and triceps strength.

exercises.name: Weighted Plank
exercises.instructions: A plank with a plate resting on your upper back for extra core demand.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with extra weight hung from a belt or held between your feet.

exercises.name: Weighted Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with a plate on your upper back, or wearing a weighted vest.

exercises.name: Weighted Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: A sit-up holding a plate at your chest for extra resistance.

exercises.name: Weighted Wall Sit
exercises.instructions: A wall sit holding a plate on your thighs for extra work.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.instructions: A push-up with your hands wider than your shoulders, putting more of the work on the chest.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A bench press with a wider grip, which shortens the range and puts more of the load on the chest.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: A lat pulldown with a wide overhand grip, pulling to your upper chest.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: A pull-up with hands wider than your shoulders, emphasizing the outer lats.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: A seated cable row with a wide bar, pulling to your upper abs to hit the upper back and rear shoulders.

exercises.name: Windmill (Kettlebell)
exercises.instructions: Holding a kettlebell locked out overhead, push your hips to the side and hinge down to touch the floor with your other hand, eyes on the bell. Builds shoulder stability and hip mobility.

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper
exercises.instructions: Hanging from a bar (or lying on your back), raise your legs and swing them side to side like windshield wipers. Hard on the obliques.

exercises.name: Woodchop (Band)
exercises.instructions: A rotational core exercise. Pull the weight diagonally across your body, from high to low or low to high, turning through your hips and torso. Anchor the band high to chop down, or low to lift up.

exercises.name: Woodchop (Cable)
exercises.instructions: A rotational core exercise. Pull the weight diagonally across your body, from high to low or low to high, turning through your hips and torso. Set the pulley high to chop down, or low to lift up.

exercises.name: Woodchop (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: A rotational core exercise. Pull the weight diagonally across your body, from high to low or low to high, turning through your hips and torso. Hold one dumbbell by its ends in both hands.

exercises.name: Woodchop (Medicine Ball)
exercises.instructions: A rotational core exercise. Pull the weight diagonally across your body, from high to low or low to high, turning through your hips and torso. Hold the ball in both hands with your arms nearly straight.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.instructions: A lunge-based mobility drill: step into a deep lunge, drop your elbow toward your front instep, rotate your arm to the sky, then straighten your front leg.

exercises.name: Wrestling
exercises.instructions: Grappling to take down and pin an opponent. Intense full-body strength and conditioning.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: With your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms up, curl the weight up with just your wrists. Builds the forearms. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Cable)
exercises.instructions: With your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms up, curl the weight up with just your wrists. Builds the forearms. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: With your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms up, curl the weight up with just your wrists. Builds the forearms. Dumbbells let you work one wrist at a time.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
exercises.instructions: Hold a bar with a rope and weight tied to it, arms straight out, and roll the weight up by twisting your wrists, then roll it back down slowly.

exercises.name: Wrist Stretch
exercises.instructions: Hold one arm straight out and gently pull the fingers back toward you, then down, to stretch the forearm and wrist.

exercises.name: Y-Raise (Cable)
exercises.instructions: Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs up, to work the lower traps and shoulders. Use light weight. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Y-Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs up, to work the lower traps and shoulders. Use light weight. Do it bent over, or lying face down on an incline bench.

exercises.name: Yates Row (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A barbell row with an underhand grip and a more upright torso, pulling to your lower stomach.

exercises.name: Yoga
exercises.instructions: Poses, breathing and movement for flexibility, strength and calm.

exercises.name: Yoke Walk
exercises.instructions: A strongman carry with a heavy yoke frame across your upper back, walking with short, quick steps.

exercises.name: Z Press (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: An overhead press seated on the floor with your legs straight in front, which takes away leg drive and back arch and demands core strength. A barbell lets you move the most weight.

exercises.name: Z Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: An overhead press seated on the floor with your legs straight in front, which takes away leg drive and back arch and demands core strength. Dumbbells work each side on its own and allow a freer, more natural path.

exercises.name: Zercher Carry (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: Walk holding a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. Hammers the upper back and core.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat (Barbell)
exercises.instructions: A squat holding the barbell in the crooks of your elbows, which keeps your torso upright and works your core and upper back hard.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.instructions: Curl up with your palms up, turn them down at the top, and lower slowly with an overhand grip. Works the biceps and forearms.
